long_biography.plain_text:
Chocolate has defined Richard Foley's working life, from childhood factory shifts to specialist distribution and bean-to-bar manufacturing. He sold chocolate to chefs as a teenager and, at 21, founded Qzina Specialty Foods in the family basement. He developed the company into a North American importer and distributor of fine chocolate and pastry ingredients before selling it in 2013.

Foley returned to manufacturing by creating ChocXO as a bean-to-bar business. The brand partnered with Chewters Chocolates, where he serves as co-founder. His work spans cocoa sourcing, product development, contract manufacturing and branded confectionery. He remains active in the combined business, directing ChocXO's expansion and the development of its American manufacturing operation.
